issues: All three cards were grey-bar placeholders, so you could not tell what page this was, and the debug name 'IMPACT BURST KIT' sat in the corner
The cards were only 400×280, together under 70% of the frame width, surrounded by empty grey
The hero and its neighbours looked identical, so the card slamming in had no visual weight; the shock ring was a faint thin blue line and the particles a few specks
There was no slot before the slam, so where the card was landing was unclear
changes: Porcelain look (cool white and cobalt): the page is a pricing section for a fictional docs tool, Inkwell, with a 76px headline and three 470×600 plan cards (Starter / Pro / Team), 100–112px prices, 30px features and CTA buttons
The Pro hero is the only dark navy surface in the frame (cobalt top glow, cobalt CTA) and springs a 'MOST POPULAR' tag after landing, so the card that slams in is the focal point

A dashed empty slot with a contact shadow that firms up as the card drops (a real slot per Q9); 0–16f the Pro card hovers in front of the lens (lift, scale, depth blur), slams into the slot in 6f ease-in, squashes for 3f and springs back

Impact: a cobalt shock ring over a white pressure disc (16f), 18 cobalt and white-paper shards stretched by velocity, an 8px 4f shake; the ring front reaches the neighbours' centres 3f later and they get pushed 34px / ±3.5° with a damped return and a horizontal smear on the push
All aftershocks are hard-clamped to zero by ~65f, followed by 75f of true stillness with only a slow push, ending on a complete pricing page; 140f total
